lines.label: A1M2-M020-010-BANSHEE
lines.speaker: Marya
lines.text: My beloved! Where is he? I must find him!

lines.label: A1M2-M020-020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: She’s reliving the moment of her death. One of these shambling corpses must be her “beloved.”

lines.label: A1M2-M020-030-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: If we put this display to rest, she may come to her senses.

lines.label: A1M2-M020-040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Understood. Let’s bring her a measure of peace.

lines.label: BansheeYesAttack2
lines.speaker: Tome Wraith
lines.text: Feel my pain!

lines.label: BansheeYesAttack3
lines.speaker: Tome Wraith
lines.text: Your soul shall burn!

lines.label: BansheePissed1
lines.speaker: Tome Wraith
lines.text: Let this torment end!

lines.label: BansheePissed2
lines.speaker: Tome Wraith
lines.text: How long must I suffer?

lines.label: A1M2-T010-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Beware, Garek. Some who are freed from the Scourge aren’t as friendly as the rest of us.

lines.label: A1M2-T020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Meaning we may have to defend ourselves?

lines.label: A1M2-T030-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Ah, you do catch on quickly.

lines.label: A1M2-T040-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You there. Sylvanas Windrunner offers you shelter in the Undercity. Head for the sewers.

lines.label: A1M2-T050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Hmm. That seemed easy enough.

lines.label: A1M2-T060-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Must you tempt fate?

lines.label: A1M2-T061-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The Scourge continue to stalk these ruins and scheme against us. Let none of them survive.

lines.label: NecromancerWarcry1
lines.speaker: Necromancer
lines.text: They'll all be mine, in the end!

lines.label: A1M2-T070-SURVIVOR
lines.speaker: Forsaken Survivor
lines.text: Must feed! Must feed now!

lines.label: A1M2-T080-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: They were mindless husks... Anya, if I had awakened like that...

lines.label: A1M2-T090-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Then I would have killed you and let Putress use you for parts. Let’s keep moving.

lines.label: A1M2-T100-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: More Scourge invaders! Quickly, rescue the Forsaken!

lines.label: A1M2-T110-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: It’s safe now. Make for the sewers. The Dark Lady watches over you.

lines.label: A1M2-T120-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Help! Anyone!

lines.label: A1M2-T130-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Get away from them!

lines.label: A1M2-T140-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Thank you! You've saved us!

lines.label: A1M2-T150-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Head for the sewers. Lady Sylvanas offers refuge to all Forsaken.

lines.label: A1M2-T160-BANSHEE
lines.speaker: Marya
lines.text: He... he’s gone. I remember now... Thank you.

lines.label: A1M2-T170-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You are free of your past. Make your way to the Undercity. The Dark Lady will bid you welcome.

lines.label: A1M2-T180-BANSHEE
lines.speaker: Alexsia
lines.text: Run away, children! The cult will slaughter us all!

lines.label: A1M2-T190-BANSHEE
lines.speaker: Alexsia
lines.text: Dead... all dead.

lines.label: A1M2-T200-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Mourn if you must. When you are ready, a new home awaits you in the Undercity.

lines.label: A1M2-T210-KAELYSTIA
lines.speaker: Kaelystia
lines.text: Who dares disturb my rest?! You will burn in the fires of my magic!

lines.label: A1M2-T220-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Enough. Your rage is misdirected. Join the Forsaken, and aim your ire at the Scourge.

lines.label: A1M2-T230-KAELYSTIA
lines.speaker: Kaelystia
lines.text: Yes... yes, you are right. Thank you, for helping me see clearly.

lines.label: A1M2-T240-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Such a bleak fate, to first be raised into undeath, and then awakened to the horror of your new existence.

lines.label: A1M2-T250-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That’s one way of looking at it. Would you rather have been left to rot, or do you embrace the chance at a second life?

lines.label: A1M2-T260-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Hard to say. I have no memories of my first one.

lines.label: A1M2-T270-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That may be a blessing in disguise. Many of us remember how we died, and what we were made to do before our free will was restored.

lines.label: A1M2-T280-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: If only we were all fortunate enough to be gifted a blank slate.

lines.label: A1M2-T300-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The living scurry amongst these ruins. We should root them out.

lines.label: A1M2-T301-SILVERHANDKNIGHT
lines.speaker: Lucian Lightforged
lines.text: More vile fields! Burn in the Light!

lines.label: A1M2-T302-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: A paladin! Slay him!

lines.label: A1M2-T310-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Keever couldn’t have found a less dangerous way to do this, could he?

lines.label: A1M2-T320-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Grand Marshal Garithos, reviled by foe and ally alike. None shed a tear when Sylvanas had him killed.

lines.label: A1M2-T330-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Strange that Keever wants to make use of his remains. Perhaps he considers it a sort of justice.

lines.label: U01Footman23
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: Kill them all!

lines.label: A1M2-T760-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Is that ghoul... reading? That's not possible.

lines.label: A1M2-T770-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Hmm. Perhaps we can use some books to lure it out.

lines.label: A1M2-T771-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It might be afraid of us. Let's back away and give it some space.

lines.label: A1M2-T772-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Something tells me Keever will find a kindred spirit in this one.

lines.label: A1M3-T010-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: There's a Dark Ranger camp ahead. Let's check in with them first.

lines.label: A1M3-T020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Anya, how did I end up in Putress’s apothecarium to begin with?

lines.label: A1M3-T030-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You were among the Scourge forces that held the Capital City when Lady Sylvanas came to claim it.

lines.label: A1M3-T040-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: After the battle, we gathered the remaining undead and sent them to Putress for... processing.

lines.label: A1M3-T050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: So I fought against Sylvanas when I was in the Scourge? And yet she welcomes me as one of the Forsaken?

lines.label: A1M3-T060-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: She understands all too well what it means to be forced to do the Lich King’s bidding.

lines.label: A1M3-T070-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: How could she turn away a newly awakened Forsaken, no matter what they had done before?

lines.label: A1M3-T080-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What about you, Anya? How did you join the Forsaken?

lines.label: A1M3-T090-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: In life, I served under Sylvanas. We both died defending our kingdom against the Scourge. And we were both raised into undeath.

lines.label: A1M3-T100-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: When I regained my free will, the Dark Lady offered me a place to belong. And for that, she has my eternal loyalty.

lines.label: A1M3-T110-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Do you remember what you were forced to do when you were under the Lich King’s control?

lines.label: A1M3-T120-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Yes. But I will not discuss it, Garek. Not with you, nor with anyone else.

lines.label: A1M3-T130-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Reliving the past will not change it. Better to move forward without looking back.

lines.label: A1M3-T140-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It seems many of the Forsaken have stories like yours. Cursed with undeath, seeking to make the most of a grim fate.

lines.label: A1M3-T150-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We are indeed united by our torment. The world sees us as monsters, and so we have only each other to rely upon.

lines.label: A1M3-T160-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then I will endeavor to be reliable. For Lady Sylvanas, and for the Forsaken.

lines.label: A1M3-T170-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: The gnoll camp is to the south of here. Don’t die! Again.

lines.label: A1M3-T180-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We’re simply going to let them set up shop in the Undercity?

lines.label: A1M3-T190-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The Forsaken need supplies, which the goblins can provide. And if they’re reliant on the Undercity for protection...

lines.label: A1M3-T200-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Then the Dark Lady can negotiate their prices from a position of strength. Impressive, Bandarion.

lines.label: A1M3-T210-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: As one of the Forsaken, you may develop an affinity for spiders. But it would still be wise to approach them with caution.

lines.label: A1M3-T220-GORDO
lines.speaker: Gordo
lines.text: Sticky webs! Gordo needs help!

lines.label: A1M3-T230-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Yet another fine mess, Gordo!

lines.label: A1M3-T240-GORDO
lines.speaker: Gordo
lines.text: Gordo free! Going back to camp now!

lines.label: A1M3-T250-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Try not to wander off again.

lines.label: A1M3-T260-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: A vile sickness festers throughout these woods.

lines.label: A1M3-T270-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The Scourge's handiwork. They sought to blight all of Lordaeron.

lines.label: A1M3-T280-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Now this land belongs to the Forsaken. We suffer neither the Scourge nor the living to intrude.

lines.label: A1M3-T290-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Murlocs. Foul creatures, but their scales are useful in alchemy.

lines.label: A1M3-T300-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That’s everything Putress wants. Let’s head back to the Undercity.

lines.label: A1M3-T310-MELISARA
lines.speaker: Melisara
lines.text: Gordo collected a few goods while he was wandering out there. They might be worth a look.

lines.label: A1M3-T320-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The quarry is on the northern edge of the woods. Let’s move.

lines.label: A1M3-T330-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It’s fortunate that Bernd remembers masonry from when he was alive. His skills will benefit the Undercity.

lines.label: A1M3-T340-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: One might say that there is value to be found in our former lives after all.

lines.label: A1M3-T350-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Hmph. You speak quite knowingly about such things, for one who awakened so recently.

lines.label: A1M3-T360-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Yes, well. It’s like you said. I do catch on quickly, don’t I?

lines.label: A1M3-T370-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Looks like the ogres have set up some fortifications.

lines.label: A1M3-T380-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Then we have a choice to make. Either we attack head on, or we look for another way in.

lines.label: A1M3-M020-010-FARANELL
lines.speaker: Faranell
lines.text: Anya, we’ve been expecting you. Putress sent us the list of reagents he requires.

lines.label: A1M3-M020-010-FARANELL
lines.speaker: Faranell
lines.text: Anya, we’ve been expecting you. Putress sent us the list of reagents he requires.

lines.label: A1M3-M020-020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: How thoughtful of him. I trust things are going well here?

lines.label: A1M3-M020-020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: How thoughtful of him. I trust things are going well here?

lines.label: A1M3-M020-030-FARANELL
lines.speaker: Faranell
lines.text: Well enough. Though I do long for the comforts of my laboratory.

lines.label: A1M3-M020-030-FARANELL
lines.speaker: Faranell
lines.text: Well enough. Though I do long for the comforts of my laboratory.

lines.label: A1M3-M020-040-MELISARA
lines.speaker: Melisara
lines.text: Anya, that idiot Gordo has gone missing again. Drag him back to camp if you find him, will you?

lines.label: A1M3-M020-040-MELISARA
lines.speaker: Melisara
lines.text: Anya, that idiot Gordo has gone missing again. Drag him back to camp if you find him, will you?

lines.label: A1M3-M020-050-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We’ll keep our eyes open. Dark Lady watch over you.

lines.label: A1M3-M020-050-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We’ll keep our eyes open. Dark Lady watch over you.

lines.label: A1M3-T390-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: With their leader slain, the rest of the ogres will scatter into the hills.

lines.label: A1M3-T400-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It’s good to know that this quarry will supply Bernd’s workforce.

lines.label: A1M3-T410-BANDITLEADER
lines.speaker: Bandit Lord
lines.text: The undead! Cut them apart and take their valuables!

lines.label: A1M3-T420-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Well, these look like the parts Keever asked us to collect.

lines.label: A1M3-M030-010-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Hey! We could use some help here! We’d make it worth your while!

lines.label: A1M3-M030-010-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Hey! We could use some help here! We’d make it worth your while!

lines.label: A1M3-M030-020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Hmm. Go on.

lines.label: A1M3-M030-020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Hmm. Go on.

lines.label: A1M3-M030-030-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: We got ambushed by gnolls and had to abandon our inventory. If you get it back for us, we’ll give you a quarter of our stock.

lines.label: A1M3-M030-030-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: We got ambushed by gnolls and had to abandon our inventory. If you get it back for us, we’ll give you a quarter of our stock.

lines.label: A1M3-M030-040-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Make it half or we walk away.

lines.label: A1M3-M030-040-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Make it half or we walk away.

lines.label: A1M3-M030-050-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Half?! That’s highway robbery!

lines.label: A1M3-M030-050-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Half?! That’s highway robbery!

lines.label: A1M3-M030-060-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Well... we've already been robbed once today. All right, deal.

lines.label: A1M3-M030-060-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Well... we've already been robbed once today. All right, deal.

lines.label: A1M3-M040-010-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Hey, you did it! And our merchandise is still intact!

lines.label: A1M3-M040-010-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Hey, you did it! And our merchandise is still intact!

lines.label: A1M3-M040-020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Indeed. Now, about our payment.

lines.label: A1M3-M040-020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Indeed. Now, about our payment.

lines.label: A1M3-M040-030-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Of course! We’d be glad to personally transport your half of the supplies to your, uh, Undercity, was it?

lines.label: A1M3-M040-030-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Of course! We’d be glad to personally transport your half of the supplies to your, uh, Undercity, was it?

lines.label: A1M3-M040-040-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: What better way to show our appreciation to our new customers--I mean--gracious hosts?

lines.label: A1M3-M040-040-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: What better way to show our appreciation to our new customers--I mean--gracious hosts?

lines.label: A1M3-M040-050-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You sneaky little--

lines.label: A1M3-M040-050-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You sneaky little--

lines.label: A1M3-M040-060-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Whoa! You get your own payment for services rendered, of course! A small token of our gratitude!

lines.label: A1M3-M040-060-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Whoa! You get your own payment for services rendered, of course! A small token of our gratitude!

lines.label: A1M3-M040-070-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Which we graciously accept. The Forsaken will benefit from your wares. See you in the city.

lines.label: A1M3-M040-070-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Which we graciously accept. The Forsaken will benefit from your wares. See you in the city.

lines.label: A1M3-T780-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That ghoul appears to be fishing. I’ve never seen that before.

lines.label: A1M3-T790-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Quickly, after them!

lines.label: OgreYesAttack1
lines.speaker: Gokrus
lines.text: Me smash you!

lines.label: A1M3-T791-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I suppose that’s one way to catch a fish. Let’s bring this ghoul back to Keever.

lines.label: A1M3-T792-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Looks like the ghoul survived the fight. Let’s bring it back to Keever.

lines.label: A1M4-T010-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: All right, Garek. You'll be alone on the track, trying to beat the other drivers' times.

lines.label: A1M4-T020-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Listen to my instructions, keep your eyes on the road, and let's win this thing!

lines.label: A1M4-T030-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Easy on the throttle, now...

lines.label: A1M4-T040-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: I said easy!

lines.label: A1M4-T050-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Ready... Set... GO!

lines.label: A1M4-T060-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Garek, you're breaking the vehicle!

lines.label: A1M4-T070-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: You have to stay on the road!

lines.label: A1M4-T080-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Triple caution! Triple caution!

lines.label: A1M4-T090-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Concentrate, Garek! Please!

lines.label: A1M4-T100-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Garek! Listen to my calls!

lines.label: A1M4-T110-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Garek, Garek, what are you doing, man?!

lines.label: A1M4-T120-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Murlocs! Look out!

lines.label: A1M4-T130-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Abomination on the road!

lines.label: A1M4-T140-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Right, right!

lines.label: A1M4-T150-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Right turn ahead!

lines.label: A1M4-T160-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Turn right, Garek!

lines.label: A1M4-T170-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Left, left!

lines.label: A1M4-T180-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Left turn coming up!

lines.label: A1M4-T190-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: To the left, Garek!

lines.label: A1M4-T200-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Home stretch! Into the finish, Garek!

lines.label: A1M4-T210-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: We won?! We won! Never doubted you for a second!

lines.label: A1M4-T220-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Not bad for an amateur. I guess.

lines.label: A1M4-T230-GLIX
lines.speaker: Glix
lines.text: Well... any race you can walk away from, yeah?

lines.label: A1M5-T010-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: This portal seems inert. Perhaps it requires a source of power.

lines.label: A1M5-T020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It looks like this could fit within the portal's frame. I'd wager it's the power source we need.

lines.label: A1M5-T030-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: These accursed mages and their little tricks. We'll have to retrace our steps.

lines.label: A1M5-T040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: This beam could probably activate the next portal if we can remove the obstacles in its path.

lines.label: A1M5-T050-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: It was an illusion! The real artifact must be elsewhere in the vault.

lines.label: A1M5-T060-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Our search continues.

lines.label: A1M5-T070-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Looks like this is the real artifact.

lines.label: A1M5-C010-010-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What is this place?

lines.label: A1M5-C010-020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: A pocket dimension, created by a mage to store all of their junk.

lines.label: A1M5-C010-030-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: As expected, it’s filled with guardian constructs and probably lined with traps as well.

lines.label: A1M5-C010-040-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We’ll have to use the portals to navigate its halls. Hopefully, there’s something worth the hassle waiting for us at the end.

lines.label: A1M5-T080-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Finally. Let's get this blasted thing back to Lexington.

lines.label: A1M6-M010-010-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Well, we’re not getting in through the front. Even if we kill all of the guards, they’ll alert everyone else to our presence.

lines.label: A1M6-M010-020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: There might be a side entrance. Let’s take a look around.

lines.label: A1M6-T010-KNIGHT
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: Intruders! Lock the doors!

lines.label: A1M6-T020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I told you this would happen. Let’s hope you were right about there being a side entrance.

lines.label: A1M6-T030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Why do these paladins hate us so much? Is it solely because we are undead?

lines.label: A1M6-T040-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That's reason enough, in their eyes. But in truth, they blame us for the fall of Lordaeron.

lines.label: A1M6-T050-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Perhaps there are some who still pursue justice, whatever that means. But most want only revenge.

lines.label: A1M6-T060-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We're in. Now to eliminate the Silver Hand.

lines.label: A1M6-T080-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Agh! It.. it burns!

lines.label: A1M6-T090-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: It's the Light! Kill the priests, quickly!

lines.label: A1M6-T100-COMMANDER
lines.speaker: Paladin
lines.text: Vile monsters! You dare defile this hallowed ground?!

lines.label: A2MU-M010-010-MOGRAINE
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: I will not meet my end in this unholy hovel!

lines.label: A2MU-M010-020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Garek, wait!

lines.label: A2MU-M010-030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Agh! It burns!

lines.label: A2MU-M010-040-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The coward escaped.

lines.label: A2MU-M010-050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then with any luck, the attack on the Undercity has ended.

lines.label: A2MU-M010-060-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I think it’s time we reported to Sylvanas.

lines.label: A2MU-M020-010-VARIMATHRAS
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: Bandarion, Anya. We have a situation in the Mage Quarter. One of the banshees has gone berserk.

lines.label: A2MU-M020-020-VARIMATHRAS
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: The mages say that a damaged mind control pylon has driven her mad. Frankly, I care not for the cause.

lines.label: A2MU-M020-030-VARIMATHRAS
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: Deal with this as you see fit. Should you have to exterminate the rampant banshee, then so be it.

lines.label: A2MU-M020-040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Hopefully, it won’t come to that. Leave this to us, Varimathras.

lines.label: A2MU-C020-010-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Well done, deathguards. Strike true, and keep your shields up.

lines.label: A2MU-C020-020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Not bad, Garek. They’re not dark rangers, but they’ll do well enough to protect the Undercity.

lines.label: A2MU-C020-030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Glad they meet with your approval, Anya.

lines.label: A2MU-C020-040-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Captain Bandarion, a word?

lines.label: A2MU-C020-050-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Several areas of the city are in need of maintenance, but I can’t get near them.

lines.label: A2MU-C020-060-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Rats are nesting in the central elevator shaft, and slimes keep pouring out of a leak in the main sewer pipe. Can you help me out?

lines.label: A2MU-C020-070-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You’re asking the captain of the guard to engage in pest control?

lines.label: A2MU-C020-080-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: To be honest, I could use the exercise. Leave it to me, Bernd.

lines.label: A2MU-T010-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: I can’t thank you enough. Here, you’ll need these torches to burn the rat nests.

lines.label: A2MU-T020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You’re much too accommodating, you know that?

lines.label: A2MU-T030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It’s my job to help people, not push them aside.

lines.label: A2MU-T040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That’s all of the rats. Let’s move onto the slimes.

lines.label: A2MU-T050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That should be everything. Let’s head back to the War Quarter.

lines.label: A2MU-T060-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I can hardly believe how much we’ve built up the Undercity over the past year.

lines.label: A2MU-T070-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: It helps that our workers need neither food nor sleep.

lines.label: A2MU-T080-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I see a lever on the pipe. Pulling it should stop the flow and prevent more slimes from emerging.

lines.label: A2MU-T090-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That should do it. Let’s head back to the War Quarter.

lines.label: A2MU-T100-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That should take care of the slimes. Now to clear out the rats.

lines.label: A2MU-T110-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Bernd will be glad to hear that his work can resume.

lines.label: A2MU-T120-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: True. Though it’s strange... his crews have never encountered issues like these before.

lines.label: A2MU-T130-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’re under attack! Deathguards, to arms!

lines.label: A2MU-T140-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Hold the line! Anya and I will secure the rest of the Undercity!

lines.label: A2MU-T150-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The War Quarter is blocked by rubble. We’ll need to load up the meat wagons to clear the way.

lines.label: A2MU-T160-GARITHOS
lines.speaker: Garithos
lines.text: Garithos kill humans! Kill them dead!

lines.label: A2MU-T170-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: With us, Garithos!

lines.label: A2MU-T180-DEATHGUARD
lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Captain Bandarion! We’ll hold this room while you push forward.

lines.label: A2MU-T190-SCARLETCAPTAIN
lines.speaker: Scarlet Crusade Captain
lines.text: Close ranks! The Light will protect you as you slay these fiends!

lines.label: A2MU-T200-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The War Quarter is secure! Deathguards, hold this ground!

lines.label: A2MU-T210-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The Scarlet Crusade... I’ve not heard of them before.

lines.label: A2MU-T220-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: They’re likely another group of Light-blinded zealots. The Silver Hand by another name.

lines.label: A2MU-T230-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Despite what they claim, I doubt it’s the Light that truly drives them.

lines.label: A2MU-T240-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Anya! Garek! Get these imbeciles off of me!

lines.label: A2MU-C030-010-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: I can’t make sense of it! There must be a reason the main pipeline has sustained so many fissures...

lines.label: A2MU-C030-020-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: I’m going to check the walls. Something must be causing damage to the pipes.

lines.label: A2MU-C030-030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’re coming with you. If there are more--

lines.label: A2MU-C030-040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Wait. Do you hear that?

lines.label: A2MU-C030-050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: <Grunt of pain and surprise.>

lines.label: A2MU-C030-060-SCARLETCRUSADER
lines.speaker: Scarlet Crusader
lines.text: We’ve breached the Undercity! These wretches will fall to the Scarlet Crusade!

lines.label: A2MU-M030-010-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Anya, Garek. Those Scarlet buffoons broke into my lab and set one of my experiments loose!

lines.label: A2MU-M030-020-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: I can’t have that specimen running rampant through the Undercity. Find and contain it at once!

lines.label: A2MU-M030-030-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: So you need our help to clean up your little mess? One might think you’d try asking more nicely.

lines.label: A2MU-M030-040-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: If you would be so kind, your assistance in this matter would be greatly appreciated.

lines.label: A2MU-M030-050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’ll handle it, Putress.

lines.label: A2MU-T250-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Took you long enough! Now watch my back as I prepare the plague!

lines.label: A2MU-T260-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Here, this may help! Or it may not.

lines.label: A2MU-T270-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Don’t say I never did anything for you!

lines.label: A2MU-T280-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: I’ve made a spare potion for you. Don’t waste it!

lines.label: A2MU-T290-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: You’re fortunate I’m here to provide some aid!

lines.label: A2MU-T300-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Drink this, and be quick about it!

lines.label: A2MU-T310-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: To think I’ve been reduced to mixing tonics for you.

lines.label: A2MU-T320-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Brewing potions liked these is beneath a Grand Apothecary.

lines.label: A2MU-T330-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Ah! The plague is ready!

lines.label: A2MU-T340-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Death to the living!

lines.label: A2MU-T350-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: I believe the Apothecarium is secure. Feel free to scurry along.

lines.label: A2MU-T360-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You’re welcome, Putress.

lines.label: A2MU-T370-VARIMATHRAS
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: Die, you pitiful zealots!

lines.label: A2MU-T380-VARIMATHRAS
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: I will deal with the rest of these vermin. Get to the Mage Quarter!

lines.label: A2MU-T390-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Months of construction, undone in moments. These fanatics will pay.

lines.label: A2MU-T400-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The Undercity can always be rebuilt. What matters now is protecting our people.

lines.label: A2MU-T410-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Garek, that pylon looks similar to the ones controlling the captives.

lines.label: A2MU-T420-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then perhaps we can use it to control the minds of our foes.

lines.label: A2MU-T430-SCARLETINQUISITOR
lines.speaker: Inquisitor
lines.text: Your dark magic has no hold on me! Suffer the Light’s judgment!

lines.label: A2MU-T440-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Hmph. Who needs magic when a blade gets the job done?

lines.label: A2MU-T450-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’ve secured the area. Let’s head for the Rogue Quarter.

lines.label: A2MU-T460-MOGRAINE
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: The Scarlet Crusade will purge your wretched kind!

lines.label: A2MU-T470-MOGRAINE
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: Monsters! You must be purified!

lines.label: A2MU-T480-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Garek! Take cover!

lines.label: A2MU-C040-010-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Anya. Captain Bandarion. Report.

lines.label: A2MU-C040-020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The Undercity is secure, but the damage from the attack is... extensive.

lines.label: A2MU-C040-030-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: We are beset by those who seek our destruction. The Forsaken villages across Tirisfal may be in grave danger.

lines.label: A2MU-C040-040-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: The Scarlet Crusade must be eliminated. Tend to the crises here if you so desire, but do not tarry in your pursuit of the zealots.

lines.label: A2MU-C040-050-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: It will be done, Dark Lady.

lines.label: A2MU-M040-010-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Captain Bandarion, I am once again in need of your aid.

lines.label: A2MU-M040-020-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: The Scarlet Crusade used explosives to blast their way into the city. In doing so, they uncovered a network of old mining tunnels.

lines.label: A2MU-M040-030-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Rather than fortifying them, I think it would be wiser to seal them off with some explosives of our own.

lines.label: A2MU-M040-040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Sounds like a plan. You give us the bombs, and we’ll make sure no one uses those tunnels again.

lines.label: A2MU-T490-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Let’s head for the center of the Undercity. We can survey the damage on the way.

lines.label: A2MU-T500-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: An attack of this scale would have taken months of planning.

lines.label: A2MU-T510-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: And a sizeable number of soldiers. They must have a stronghold nearby.

lines.label: A2MU-T520-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: The Trade Quarter is under heavy repair. Avoid it for now and head directly to the surface.

lines.label: A2MU-T530-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Be careful with those. Don’t want to get caught in the blast radius!

lines.label: A2MU-T540-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: These tunnels are old and abandoned. They must have been left empty for a long time.

lines.label: A2MU-T550-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Scarlet Crusaders! Kill them and plant the explosives!

lines.label: A2MU-T560-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That’s one breach down. Let’s close the others.

lines.label: A2MU-T570-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What is this place?

lines.label: A2MU-T580-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I don’t know. But it’s ancient. Perhaps older than Lordaeron itself.

lines.label: A2MU-T590-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It’s some kind of altar. And... I can feel it calling to me...

lines.label: A2MU-T600-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Sounds like that was quite the adventure. I wonder what else lies buried all around us.

lines.label: A2MU-M045-010-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Captain Bandarion, if you’re headed to the surface again, I have a small request for you.

lines.label: A2MU-M045-020-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: The Dark Lady has tasked me with repairing the villages that were attacked by the Scarlet Crusade.

lines.label: A2MU-M045-030-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: But before I can start, I need a detailed report of the damage so I can plan accordingly. Can you gather that information for me?

lines.label: A2MU-M045-040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Of course. I’ll check in with the villagers and get back to you.

lines.label: A2MU-T610-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: It seems the Scarlet Crusade found more than they bargained for.

lines.label: A2MU-T611-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Take this serum with you. It will grant you temporary control of the lesser experiments.

lines.label: A2MU-T611-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Take this serum with you. It will grant you temporary control of the lesser experiments.

lines.label: A2MU-T612-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We might have, too. Maybe the larger specimens could force that thing back into its cell.

lines.label: A2MU-T612-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We might have, too. Maybe the larger specimens could force that thing back into its cell.

lines.label: A2MU-T613-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It's weakened! The other specimens should be able to push it back!

lines.label: A2MU-T614-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: No wonder the Scarlet Crusade fell to that monstrosity.

lines.label: A2MU-T615-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Looks like we had to eliminate Putress's little pet. Oh well.

lines.label: A2MU-T630-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: I’ll have to start a new specimen from scratch. Months of experimentation down the drain!

lines.label: A2MU-T640-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: I’ll study that specimen later. No doubt slaying those Scarlet fools will result in valuable data.

lines.label: A2MU-T650-LEXINGTON
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: Captain Bandarion, thank the Dark Lady you’re here! We need time to realign the runes on the pylon!

lines.label: A2MU-T660-LEXINGTON
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: Keep that banshee from attacking us, and we can end this without bloodshed!

lines.label: A2MU-T661-LEXINGTON
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: You needn't kill the banshee, merely hold it at bay!

lines.label: A2MU-T662-LEXINGTON
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: We're making progress on the repairs. Keep it up!

lines.label: A2MU-T663-LEXINGTON
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: The pylon is nearly restored!

lines.label: A2MU-T670-LEXINGTON
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: No! If only we had worked faster, this fate could have been avoided.

lines.label: A2MU-T680-LEXINGTON
lines.speaker: Lexington
lines.text: Excellent! I’ll have to reinforce these pylons in the future.

lines.label: A2MU-T690-VARIMATHRAS
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: I hear the screaming has ceased. Whatever you did to stop it, you’ve earned your reward.

lines.label: A2MU-T700-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: How very generous of you.

lines.label: A2MU-T710-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Make your preparations. Once we lay siege to the Scarlet Monastery, there will be no turning back.

lines.label: A2MU-T720-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: It'll take weeks to repair the damage the Scarlet Crusade has done. I'd better get to work.

lines.label: A2MU-T730-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Hmm, is that all the blood you could find? I suppose a small sample is better than none.

lines.label: A2MU-C050-010-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Leonid Barthalomew. I had not expected to see you in these halls again.

lines.label: A2MU-C050-020-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Forgive my intrusion, Lady Windrunner. The circumstances demand it.

lines.label: A2MU-C050-030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’ve pushed back the Scarlet Crusade, but they gather strength within their monastery.

lines.label: A2MU-C050-040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Leonid has been monitoring their movements and can show our troops where to strike.

lines.label: A2MU-C050-050-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: I see. And what say you, Anya? Can we trust Leonid in this matter?

lines.label: A2MU-C050-060-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I am loathe to trust anyone who serves the Light. Much less one who deserted his own people.

lines.label: A2MU-C050-070-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: But... Leonid has proven to be reliable. And he put himself in peril to defend our villages.

lines.label: A2MU-C050-080-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Very well. Let the Scarlet Crusade rue the day they made enemies of the Forsaken.

lines.label: A2MU-M050-010-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Ah, just the laborers I was hoping to see.

lines.label: A2MU-M050-020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: What is it now, Putress?

lines.label: A2MU-M050-030-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: Surely you’ve noticed that some of Tirisfal’s fauna have undergone strange transformations as of late.

lines.label: A2MU-M050-040-PUTRESS
lines.speaker: Putress
lines.text: I would very much like to study their blood. Procure some for me, and you will be well compensated.

lines.label: A2MU-M050-050-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Very well. But this had better be worth it, Putress.

lines.label: A2MU-T590-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It’s some kind of altar. And... I can feel it calling to me...

lines.label: A2MU-T591-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That... was an unusual experience.

lines.label: A2MU-T592-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Not sure what I expected... but it certainly wasn’t that.

lines.label: A2MU-T593-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: What vile sorcery was that?

lines.label: A2M2-M005-010-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That smoke is coming from Brill! It must be the Scarlet Crusade!

lines.label: A2M2-M005-020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then we have no time to spare. Let's move!

lines.label: A2M2-T010-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Stay back! You profane the Light with your every action!

lines.label: A2M2-T020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: He's Forsaken! Quickly, we have to help him!

lines.label: A2M2-T030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The Argent Dawn sent you here alone?

lines.label: A2M2-T040-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: My orders were to monitor the Scarlet Crusade and remain unseen. But I could not stand idle as they torched these villages.

lines.label: A2M2-C010-010-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Scarlet Crusade is in retreat.  I must return to the Argent Dawn and report on what has transpired.

lines.label: A2M2-C010-020-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I ask that the two of you accompany me. Your knowledge of Tirisfal, and particularly of the Forsaken, exceeds my own.

lines.label: A2M2-C010-030-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Do not think for a moment that we would tell your paladins anything about the Forsaken.

lines.label: A2M2-C010-040-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: When will you realize that we are on the same side?

lines.label: A2M2-C010-050-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Just because we share a common foe does not make us allies.

lines.label: A2M2-C010-060-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Anya, Leonid has risked his life to fight beside us.  I think he's earned the benefit of the doubt.

lines.label: A2M2-C010-070-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: My doubt is all I'm willing to offer. But if you trust him... then I'll stow my arrows for now.

lines.label: A2M2-C010-080-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I'm sure the Argent Dawn will be much obliged.  Let's not keep them waiting.

lines.label: A2M2-M010-010-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Are you all right, friend? I'm Garek Bandarion, captain of--

lines.label: A2M2-M010-020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Anya?! What are you doing?! He's Forsaken! One of us!

lines.label: A2M2-M010-030-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: No. He could have been one of us. Instead he chose to walk away.

lines.label: A2M2-M010-040-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: She is correct.

lines.label: A2M2-M010-050-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: My name is Leonid Barthalomew, knight of the Argent Dawn.

lines.label: A2M2-M010-060-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Like us, he was freed from the Scourge. And then he left the Dark Lady's side to join these paladins.

lines.label: A2M2-M010-061-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I'm surprised they didn't slay you the moment you approached them.

lines.label: A2M2-M010-070-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Scarlet Crusade and the Argent Dawn are nothing alike.  Despite my... condition, the Argent Dawn welcomed me with open arms.

lines.label: A2M2-M010-071-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: While the Scarlet zealots tarnish the legacy of the Silver Hand, we seek to uphold it.

lines.label: A2M2-M010-080-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You wear a different tabard, but it's cut from the same cloth.

lines.label: A2M2-M010-090-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Enough.  While we argue, the Scarlet Crusade continues to raze Tirisfal.

lines.label: A2M2-M010-100-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We need to act swiftly if we are to save the other villages.

lines.label: A2M2-M010-110-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I swear by the Light to aid you in your fight against the Crusade.

lines.label: A2M2-M010-120-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: To hell with your Light. You'll help us or I'll end you myself.

lines.label: A2M2-T050-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Then at least you have not completely abandoned your kind.

lines.label: A2M2-T060-Garek
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It seems we’re too late. We should search for survivors.

lines.label: A2M2-T070-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The village was ransacked. Almost as if it were raided for supplies.

lines.label: A2M2-T080-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Fel magic. For all their faults, the Scarlet Crusade would never dabble in such vile sorcery.

lines.label: A2M2-T090-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: This axe is of orcish make. Blackrock clan.

lines.label: A2M2-T091-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Arthas and Uther drove them from these lands before the plague began. These must be holdouts.

lines.label: A2M2-T100-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Wolf tracks. If we follow them, they'll lead us back to the orcs.

lines.label: A2M2-T110-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It might be a good idea to root them out. They're not the Crusade, but they can still pose a threat.

lines.label: ScarletFootman_Warcry1
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: For the Scarlet Crusade!

lines.label: A2M2-T120-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Leonid, you are a knight of the Argent Dawn, but not a paladin?

lines.label: A2M2-M020-010-MAGISTRATESEVREN
lines.speaker: Magistrate Sevren
lines.text: Captain Bandarion, we are in need of your assistance.

lines.label: A2M2-M020-020-MagistrateSevren
lines.speaker: Magistrate Sevren
lines.text: Repairs have been halted because a group of goblins raided our stockpile of lumber. Can you reclaim it for us?

lines.label: A2M2-M020-030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Of course. Leave it to us, Sevren.

lines.label: A2M2-T130-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Calling upon the Holy Light burns me from within. The undead are not meant to wield such divine power.

lines.label: A2M2-T140-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: At least that's something we can agree on.

lines.label: A2M2-T150-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The Scarlet Crusade have been using these watchtowers to spy on us. It would be wise to reclaim them.

lines.label: ScarletMarksman_Ready1
lines.speaker: Marksman
lines.text: None can hide from the Light!

lines.label: A2M2-T160-FORSAKENGUARD
lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Captain Bandarion! Deathknell is under attack!

lines.label: A2M2-T170-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Send word to the Undercity, we'll protect the civilians.

lines.label: A2M2-T180-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That seems to be all of them. We should move on.

lines.label: A2M2-T190-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: It pains me to see the Scarlet Crusade twist their faith into zealotry.

lines.label: A2M2-T200-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Justice, compassion, holiness, protection. Yet the Crusade seems to value only retribution.

lines.label: A2M2-M030-010-GOBLINTINKER
lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: Oh, uh, hey!  Are you from... what's that town's name, again?

lines.label: A2M2-M030-010-GOBLINTINKER
lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: Oh, uh, hey!  Are you from... what's that town's name, again?

lines.label: A2M2-M030-020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Brill. And yes, we are. Give back the lumber, and no one gets hurt.

lines.label: A2M2-M030-020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Brill. And yes, we are. Give back the lumber, and no one gets hurt.

lines.label: A2M2-M030-030-GOBLINTINKER
lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: Afraid I can't do that, boss.  We need it in order to finish our little zeppelin here.

lines.label: A2M2-M030-030-GOBLINTINKER
lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: Afraid I can't do that, boss.  We need it in order to finish our little zeppelin here.

lines.label: A2M2-M030-040-GOBLINTINKER
lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: But... you look the other way, and maybe you'll find some gold on the ground.  You get what I mean?

lines.label: A2M2-M030-040-GOBLINTINKER
lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: But... you look the other way, and maybe you'll find some gold on the ground.  You get what I mean?

lines.label: A2M2-M030-050-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Your bribes mean nothing to us.  The people of Brill need that lumber to rebuild their homes.

lines.label: A2M2-M030-050-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Your bribes mean nothing to us.  The people of Brill need that lumber to rebuild their homes.

lines.label: A2M2-M030-060-GOBLINTINKER
lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: Homes?  You're a bunch of walking corpses!  Dig a hole and jump in it!

lines.label: A2M2-M030-060-GOBLINTINKER
lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: Homes?  You're a bunch of walking corpses!  Dig a hole and jump in it!

lines.label: A2M2-M030-070-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Well, Garek?  Do we take their gold, or take their lives?

lines.label: A2M2-M030-070-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Well, Garek?  Do we take their gold, or take their lives?

lines.label: A2M2-M030-080-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We've seen enough violence today. We can get Brill the lumber it needs from elsewhere.

lines.label: A2M2-T210-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: You are familiar with the tenets of the Silver Hand? Were you perhaps a paladin in life?

lines.label: A2M2-T220-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I... don't know. I have no memories from before my awakening. What I know of the Light, I studied in undeath.

lines.label: A2M2-T230-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: A waste of time, I say. The Light abhors the Forsaken, and the feeling is mutual.

lines.label: A2M2-T240-WHITEMANE
lines.speaker: Sally Whitemane
lines.text: Lordaeron must be purged of this undead filth!

lines.label: A2M2-T250-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That lunatic!  We have to stop her!

lines.label: A2M2-T260-WHITEMANE
lines.speaker: Sally Whitemane
lines.text: You will not claim my life, heathens!  When I return, I will see you engulfed in flames!

lines.label: A2M2-T270-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: How did you come to join the Argent Dawn, and not the Forsaken?

lines.label: A2M2-T280-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: When Lady Sylvanas offered me a place in the Undercity, I found that I... could not accept it.

lines.label: A2M2-M040-010-EXECUTORARREN
lines.speaker: Executor Arren
lines.text: Glad you're here, Captain Bandarion. We have a situation on our hands.

lines.label: A2M2-M040-020-EXECUTORARREN
lines.speaker: Executor Arren
lines.text: The recent fighting has given rise to a death revenant in the town's graveyard.  It could pose a threat if we don't deal with it soon.

lines.label: A2M2-T290-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Undeath is a malady. My hope is that one day, the Light may cure me of it and return me to the living.

lines.label: A2M2-T300-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You're a delusional fool. Better to accept what you are than to cling to what you used to be.

lines.label: A2M2-T310-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: What you call delusion, I call hope. The Light can perform miracles for those who keep faith.

lines.label: A2M2-T320-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: This seems like one of the beasts Putress mentioned. Let's bring its blood back to Apothecarium.

lines.label: A2M2-T321-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Murlocs. Always in need of culling.

lines.label: A2M2-T330-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: More goblins in Tirisfal. I wonder what they're up to.

lines.label: A2M2-T340-GOBLINTINKER
lines.speaker: Rooz the Crafty
lines.text: Big mistake, pal!

lines.label: A2M2-T350-MagistrateSevren
lines.speaker: Magistrate Sevren
lines.text: I take it you did not retrieve the lumber.  I suppose I will have to ask Bernd for more of it.

lines.label: A2M2-T360-MagistrateSevren
lines.speaker: Magistrate Sevren
lines.text: You have my gratitude. Now we can continue rebuilding Brill.

lines.label: A2M2-M050-010-SEDRICKCALSTON
lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Ah, Captain Bandarion! Perhaps you can help me with this predicament.

lines.label: A2M2-M050-020-OLSON
lines.speaker: Olson
lines.text: The only predicament is you haven't yet arrested this murderer!

lines.label: A2M2-M050-020-ANDRE
lines.speaker: Andre
lines.text: Me?! He was clearly poisoned! That makes you the prime suspect!

lines.label: A2M2-M050-030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Enough. What happened here?

lines.label: A2M2-M050-040-SEDRICKCALSTON
lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Someone used the Scarlet Crusade's attack to cover up a murder. Poor Saloman here was found dead, but he was nowhere near the battle.

lines.label: A2M2-M050-050-SEDRICKCALSTON
lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: These two were the only villagers unaccounted for during the fray. Olson, the town alchemist, and Andre, the town huntsman.

lines.label: A2M2-M050-060-SEDRICKCALSTON
lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Can you please investigate this matter for me? I have my hands full trying to get the town in order.

lines.label: A2M2-M050-070-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I'm not much of an investigator, Sedrick. But I'll do what I can.

lines.label: A2M2-M050-080-SEDRICKCALSTON
lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Speak to me once you've completed your investigation and have determined who did the deed.

lines.label: A2M2-T370-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Revenants are a dreadful foe, even for the undead.

lines.label: A2M2-T380-EXECUTORARREN
lines.speaker: Executor Arren
lines.text: With the revenant gone, we can focus on repairing the damage from the attack. Deathknell thanks you yet again.

lines.label: A2M2-T390-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Froth around the victim's mouth. Seems like poison... but there's also an arrow wound in his back.

lines.label: A2M2-T400-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: An unpaid invoice for alchemical reagents. It seems Olson owed Saloman quite a bit of gold.

lines.label: A2M2-T410-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: This is Saloman's barn, but these pelts seem expensive and expertly prepared. Could he have stolen them from Andre?

lines.label: A2M2-T420-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Whatever's in this mug, it isn't merely ale. I can smell something just beneath the surface.

lines.label: A2M2-T430-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It seems like whoever last held this bow was in a hurry to get rid of it.

lines.label: A2M2-T440-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: A letter from Olson, asking Saloman to discuss his debt over a mug of ale. This would have been just before the Scarlet attack.

lines.label: A2M2-T450-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: A letter from Andre, saying he knows Saloman has been stealing his pelts and demanding he return them by today... or else.

lines.label: A2M2-M060-010-SEDRICKCALSTON
lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Well, Captain Bandarion?  What have you found?

lines.label: A2M2-M060-020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It was Andre.  This was the work of a marksman with a vendetta.

lines.label: A2M2-M060-030-SEDRICKCALSTON
lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Hmm.  That doesn't explain the frothing around Saloman's mouth... but I suppose you're the expert.

lines.label: A2M2-M060-040-ANDRE
lines.speaker: Andre
lines.text: What?! This is outrageous! I'm innocent!

lines.label: A2M2-M060-050-OLSON
lines.speaker: Olson
lines.text: Deny it all you want! The case is closed!

lines.label: A2M2-M060-060-SEDRICKCALSTON
lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: You're under arrest, Andre. Come with me.

lines.label: A2M2-M060-070-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It was Olson. This was the work of an alchemist with access to deadly potions.

lines.label: A2M2-M060-080-SEDRICKCALSTON
lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Hmm. That doesn't explain the wound in Saloman's back... but I suppose you're the expert.

lines.label: A2M2-M060-090-OLSON
lines.speaker: Olson
lines.text: What? No! It wasn't me!

lines.label: A2M2-M060-100-ANDRE
lines.speaker: Andre
lines.text: Of course it was!  We've known it all along!

lines.label: A2M2-M060-110-SEDRICKCALSTON
lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: You're under arrest, Olson. Come with me.

lines.label: A2M2-M060-120-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It was both of them.  Olson poisoned Saloman's ale to get out of paying his debt.  Andre wanted revenge for being robbed of his pelts.

lines.label: A2M2-M060-130-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: They both did the deed.  The Scarlet Crusade's attack was serendipity... and the perfect cover up.

lines.label: A2M2-M060-140-OLSON
lines.speaker: Olson
lines.text: I had no choice!  My debt would have ruined me!

lines.label: A2M2-M060-150-ANDRE
lines.speaker: Andre
lines.text: That thief got what was coming to him!

lines.label: A2M2-M060-160-SEDRICKCALSTON
lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: Listen to yourselves!  You're both under arrest!  Come with me at once.

lines.label: A2M2-M060-170-SEDRICKCALSTON
lines.speaker: Sedrick Calston
lines.text: What a dreadful affair.  Thank you for helping me sort it out, Captain Bandarion.

lines.label: A2M3-T010-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Orcs. They’ve been a stain on these lands for years.

lines.label: A2M3-T020-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Not all of them. But the Blackrock clan are known for their brutal raiders.

lines.label: A2M3-T030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then let’s discourage them from raiding the Forsaken.

lines.label: A2M3-T040-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The deed is done. Perhaps the other orcs will heed the warning.

lines.label: A2M3-T050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Leonid, you said not all orcs threaten these lands. Have you met others?

lines.label: A2M3-T060-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Yes, in the Argent Dawn. I've heard rumors of a young warchief who led many of the orcs across the sea.

lines.label: A2M3-T061-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: It is said he is forming a "new Horde" that values strength and honor.

lines.label: A2M3-T070-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I’ll believe that when I see it.

lines.label: HeroBladeMasterYesAttack3
lines.speaker: Nikoro
lines.text: Taste my blade!

lines.label: FootmanReady1
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: Ready for action!

lines.label: PriestYes1
lines.speaker: Priest
lines.text: I am your servant.

lines.label: FootmanWhat4
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: Say the word.

lines.label: RiflemanReady1
lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Locked and loaded!

lines.label: A2M4-T010-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Argent Dawn had to garrison in ogre territory. We may have to fight our way up the hill.

lines.label: A2M4-T020-ARGENTDAWNCAPTIVE
lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: Leonid! The ogres took our patrols prisoner! The fort is under attack!

lines.label: A2M4-T030-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: What?! Then there's no time to spare! We must rescue the others and break the siege!

lines.label: A2M4-T060-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: By the Light's grace, we're not too late! The fort's gates still hold!

lines.label: A2M4-T070-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: They won't for much longer. We have to end this siege now!

lines.label: A2M4-T080-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The siege is broken, and the rest of the ogres will scatter into the hills. Let's head into the fort.

lines.label: A2M4-C010-010-TYROSUS
lines.speaker: Lord Tyrosus
lines.text: The Scourge have found us! Argent Dawn, to arms!

lines.label: A2M4-C010-011-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I knew this would happen!

lines.label: A2M4-C010-012-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Lord Tyrosus! These Forsaken are under my protection.

lines.label: A2M4-C010-013-TYROSUS
lines.speaker: Lord Tyrosus
lines.text: Leonid, thank the Light you've returned! Then these undead...

lines.label: A2M4-C010-014-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Are the same as I am. And they are under attack from the Scarlet Crusade.

lines.label: A2M4-C010-020-TYROSUS
lines.speaker: Lord Tyrosus
lines.text: Those fanatics must be stopped.

lines.label: A2M4-C010-030-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Do you truly expect us to believe there’s any difference between you?

lines.label: A2M4-C010-040-TYROSUS
lines.speaker: Lord Tyrosus
lines.text: We were once all Knights of the Silver Hand. But those who sought vengeance for Lordaeron twisted the order into the Scarlet Crusade.

lines.label: A2M4-C010-050-TYROSUS
lines.speaker: Lord Tyrosus
lines.text: We who held fast to the true teachings of the Light left and formed the Argent Dawn.

lines.label: A2M4-C010-060-TYROSUS
lines.speaker: Lord Tyrosus
lines.text: Alas, we are few in number. The Crusade grow strong within their monastery, and we have little hope of defeating them in battle.

lines.label: A2M4-C010-070-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: This monastery... could you lead us to it?

lines.label: A2M4-C010-080-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: You may not have the forces to lay siege to the Crusade’s stronghold, but the Forsaken do.

lines.label: A2M4-C010-090-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You would have us fight their war for them?

lines.label: A2M4-C010-091-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It's our war as well. The Scarlet Crusade is sure to strike the Undercity again.

lines.label: A2M4-C010-100-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I will lead you to them. I doubt Lady Sylvanas would trust anyone else from the Argent Dawn.

lines.label: A2M4-C010-110-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You'll be lucky if she trusts you.

lines.label: A2M4-C010-120-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then it’s settled. Light guide our path.

lines.label: A2M4-T090-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It's time to let Lady Sylvanas know what we've learned.

lines.label: A2M4-T100-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Do not expect a warm homecoming, Leonid. Not all Forsaken are as forgiving as I am.

lines.label: A2M5-M010-010-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Your intelligence was accurate, Leonid. Now for the battle itself.

lines.label: A2M5-M010-020-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: The path to the Scarlet Monastery is heavily fortified. Our numbers are limited, so we must strike with discretion and precision.

lines.label: A2M5-M010-030-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: You are to slip behind enemy lines, break their defenses, and eliminate their commanders.

lines.label: A2M5-M010-040-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: But be warned: if the tide turns against us, I will not hesitate to call for a retreat. Move swiftly, before victory evades our grasp.

lines.label: A2M5-M010-050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It will be done, Dark Lady.

lines.label: A2M5-T010-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Our troops are on the move. We need to clear out the Scarlet Crusade's defenses or they'll be marching into a death trap.

lines.label: A2M5-T020-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Many Forsaken have fallen, but the victory is still within reach!

lines.label: A2M5-T030-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: We have lost half of our forces the Crusade's defenses. Do not allow this battle to drag on!

lines.label: A2M5-T040-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: We cannot maintain the siege for much longer! Finish this, now!

lines.label: A2M5-T050-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Enough! I will not sacrifice any more Forsaken to a lost cause! Fall back to the Undercity!

lines.label: A2M5-T060-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Those archers will make short work of our army. Eliminate them.

lines.label: A2M5-T070-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The high ground is ours. Let's push forward!

lines.label: A2M5-T080-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Dark rangers are skirmishing with crusaders across the forest. My sisters can join us if we come to their aid.

lines.label: ForsakenRanger_Ready1
lines.speaker: Forsaken Ranger
lines.text: I serve the Banshee Queen!

lines.label: ForsakenVillagerF_What1
lines.speaker: Forsaken Ranger
lines.text: Greetings!

lines.label: A2M5-T110-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I have heard of a barracks nearby where the Crusade is keeping captive Forsaken troops. We should rescue them if we can.

lines.label: A2M5-T120-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: With us, soldiers! We march on the Scarlet Monastery!

lines.label: A2M5-T130-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Slaughtered, all of them. This is what awaits us if the Crusade wins.

lines.label: A2M5-T140-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Our forces will be hard pressed to break that shield wall. Flank the Scarlets and ambush their captain.

lines.label: A2M5-T150-SCARLETCAPTAIN
lines.speaker: Captain Tychos
lines.text: The undead strike from the high ground! Do not let them pass!

lines.label: A2M5-T160-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The phalanx is broken! Our army pushes forward!

lines.label: A2M5-T170-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Crusade will respond in kind. We must reach the monastery soon.

lines.label: A2M5-T180-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That inquisitor will use the Light to incinerate our forces. We need to slay him!

lines.label: A2M5-T190-SCARLETINQUISITOR
lines.speaker: Inquisitor Kerran
lines.text: Vile monsters! Burn in holy fire!

lines.label: A2M5-T200-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Good riddance. Now our army can advance.

lines.label: A2M5-T220-SCARLETCRUSADER
lines.speaker: Crusader Artonius
lines.text: No! Your siege ends here!

lines.label: A2M5-T230-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Crusade has only one line of defense remaining. The monastery lies ahead!

lines.label: A2M5-T240-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then it's time to end this battle!

lines.label: FootmanYesAttack2
lines.speaker: Scarlet Footman
lines.text: Attack!

lines.label: ScarletMarksman_Warcry1
lines.speaker: Scarlet Marksman
lines.text: I'll mount your head on a wall!

lines.label: FootmanYesAttack3
lines.speaker: Scarlet Footman
lines.text: To arms!

lines.label: FootmanYesAttack2
lines.speaker: Scarlet Footman
lines.text: Attack!

lines.label: KnightWarcry1
lines.speaker: Crusader
lines.text: For Honor! For Freedom!

lines.label: A2M5-C010-010-MOGRAINE
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: You again. This time, you will be purged from Lordaeron.

lines.label: A2M5-C010-020-WHITEMANE
lines.speaker: Sally
lines.text: My champion, destroy these monsters!

lines.label: A2M5-C010-030-MOGRAINE
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: For the Scarlet Crusade!

lines.label: A2M5-C010-040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Forsaken, attack!

lines.label: A2M5-T250-WHITEMANE
lines.speaker: High Inquisitor Whitemane
lines.text: We will attack as one!

lines.label: A2M5-T260-mograine
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: At your side, milady!

lines.label: A2M5-T270-MOGRAINE
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: Face me, monsters!

lines.label: A2M5-T280-MOGRAINE
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: You shall all be purified!

lines.label: A2M5-T290-MOGRAINE
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: None can oppose the Scarlet Crusade!

lines.label: A2M5-T300-MOGRAINE
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: You dare strike at the High Inquisitor?!

lines.label: A2M5-T310-MOGRAINE
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: Your wretched existence ends here!

lines.label: A2M5-T320-WHITEMANE
lines.speaker: High Inquisitor Whitemane
lines.text: Fight on, my champion!

lines.label: A2M5-T330-WHITEMANE
lines.speaker: High Inquisitor Whitemane
lines.text: The Light protects those who serve it!

lines.label: A2M5-T340-WHITEMANE
lines.speaker: High Inquisitor Whitemane
lines.text: We will be victorious!

lines.label: A2M5-T350-WHITEMANE
lines.speaker: High Inquisitor Whitemane
lines.text: Drive back these heathens, Mograine!

lines.label: A2M5-T360-WHITEMANE
lines.speaker: High Inquisitor Whitemane
lines.text: Let the flame of salvation burn!

lines.label: A2M5-T370-MOGRAINE
lines.speaker: Scarlet Commander Mograine
lines.text: They are gaining ground, milady! We must fall back to defend the monastery!

lines.label: A2M5-T380-WHITEMANE
lines.speaker: High Inquisitor Whitemane
lines.text: Very well. One day, these unholy abominations will pay for their treachery!

lines.label: A2M5-C020-010-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: We’ve retaken Tirisfal Glades. The zealots retreat to their monastery.

lines.label: A2M5-C020-020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We should storm their stronghold and exterminate them for good.

lines.label: A2M5-C020-030-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Memories of Landen
lines.text: Survival is the real victory, and peace is its reward.

lines.label: A2M5-C020-040-LANDEN
lines.speaker: Memories of Landen
lines.text: Never lose sight of that.

lines.label: A2M5-C020-070-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Lady Sylvanas. I think we should return to the Undercity.

lines.label: A2M5-C020-080-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’ve pushed back the Crusade, but at great cost. If we assault the monastery now...

lines.label: A2M5-C020-081-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We Forsaken can't replenish our numbers. Every loss brings us closer to extinction. Is taking the monastery truly worth that risk?

lines.label: A2M5-C020-090-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: I see the wisdom of your counsel. We will claim this victory, and be content in securing our territory.

lines.label: A2M5-C020-100-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I will apprise the Argent Dawn of battle’s outcome. Should the Crusade stir again, the Forsaken will be the first to hear of it.

lines.label: A2M5-C020-110-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: It was good to stand beside you both. Know that I will always count you as an ally.

lines.label: A2M5-C020-120-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You... were useful. Try not to let those paladins change that.

lines.label: A2M5-C020-130-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: The Crusade will rise again. The Light compels them to destroy us.

lines.label: A2M5-C020-140-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Perhaps. But I think that their hatred would drive them with or without the Light.

lines.label: A2M5-C020-150-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: And I believe that there are those who would wield the Light in other ways. Maybe even in defense of the Forsaken.

lines.label: A2M5-C020-160-CULTASSASSIN
lines.speaker: Scourge Assassin
lines.text: So the Scarlet Crusade and the Forsaken have bled each other dry.

lines.label: A2M5-C020-170-CULTASSASSIN
lines.speaker: Scourge Assassin
lines.text: Then the hour of the Scourge will soon be at hand.

lines.label: A2M5-T555-DEATHGUARD
lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Captain! Our meat wagons can take down that tower, but we need to get rid of the cannons first!

lines.label: A3I-C010-010-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Bernd is requesting a deathguard escort for his loggers. Apparently he wants to harvest lumber from Silverpine.

lines.label: A3I-C010-020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Did he complain about the “quality of the trees” in Tirisfal again?

lines.label: A3I-C010-030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: As always. I tried to tell him that the forests in Silverpine are rife with danger. Better to stay near the Undercity, where it's--

lines.label: A3I-C010-040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: ...safe.

lines.label: A3I-C010-050-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: No...

lines.label: A3M1-C010-010-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Anya! Captain Bandarion! Over here!

lines.label: A3M1-C010-020-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Lady Sylvanas, what the hell is that thing?!

lines.label: A3M1-C010-030-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Naxxramas. An ancient necropolis repurposed into a flying fortress, home to the archlich Kel'Thuzad.

lines.label: A3M1-C010-040-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: It boasts immense destructive power, but leveling the city's ruins was not the Scourge's goal.

lines.label: A3M1-C010-050-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: That blast breached the surface, creating an entrance to the Undercity. They seek to invade and reclaim it from the Forsaken.

lines.label: A3M1-C010-060-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: I can keep the skies clear, but their ground forces are on the march. Our forward defenses will only hold for so long.

lines.label: A3M1-C010-070-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We'll reinforce them with whatever forces we can muster.

lines.label: A3M1-C010-080-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The Scourge will not reach the Undercity, Dark Lady. This I swear.

lines.label: A3M1-C010-090-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Good. Now go. The fate of the Forsaken is in your hands.

lines.label: A3M1-T010-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Rally what forces you can. There may also be others across the battlefield who require your aid.

lines.label: A3M1-T020-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Stopping the ground assault won't accomplish anything if Naxxramas fires on us again.

lines.label: A3M1-T030-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then we'll have to find a way to bring it down.

lines.label: A3M1-T040-DEATHGUARD
lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Captain Bandarion! We've secured positions at two other bridges, but they won't hold for long!

lines.label: A3M1-T050-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We'll deploy additional troops as needed. Stand strong until we have no choice but to fall back!

lines.label: DeathKnightWarcry1
lines.speaker: Death Knight
lines.text: Let terror reign!

lines.label: HeroLichYesAttack1
lines.speaker: Lich
lines.text: Embrace the end!

lines.label: NerubianCryptLordPissed1
lines.speaker: Crypt Lord
lines.text: The Scourge will devour all!

lines.label: A3M1-T060-DEATHGUARD
lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Good of you to join the fight, Captain Bandarion!

lines.label: A3M1-T070-DEATHGUARD
lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: These Scourge maggots are going to regret attacking our home!

lines.label: AbominationWhat1
lines.speaker: Abomination
lines.text: What we do?

lines.label: A3M1-T080-DEATHGUARD
lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Heh. It takes more than this to defeat the Forsaken!

lines.label: A3M1-T100-VARIMATHRAS
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: This bridge is lost! Fall back while I cover you!

lines.label: A3M1-T110-VARIMATHRAS
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: We cannot hold this position! Head back to the Undercity!

lines.label: A3M1-T120-VARIMATHRAS
lines.speaker: Varimathras
lines.text: There are too many of them! Retreat while you still can!

lines.label: A3M1-T130-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Is there no end to them?!

lines.label: A3M1-T140-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Hold your ground! If we falter here, the Forsaken are lost!

lines.label: A3M1-T150-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Knights of the Argent Dawn! Strike down these Scourge heathens!

lines.label: A3M1-T160-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That's Leonid! The Argent Dawn have joined the battle!

lines.label: A3M1-T170-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We've secured the ruins! Regroup at the entrance to the Undercity!

lines.label: A3M1-C020-010-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Your arrival was timely, Leonid. And unexpected.

lines.label: A3M1-C020-020-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: We guessed at the Scourge's intentions when we saw Naxxramas make way toward the Undercity. It cannot be allowed to remain aloft.

lines.label: A3M1-C020-030-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Scourge have deployed their forces via skybarge. If we were to commandeer one, we could use it to reach the necropolis.

lines.label: A3M1-C020-040-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: A skybarge can only transport a few of us at a time. How do we destroy Naxxramas once we're up there?

lines.label: A3M1-C020-050-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: I might be able to help with that.

lines.label: A3M1-C020-060-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: These are the explosives I hand out to my demolition crews.

lines.label: A3M1-C020-070-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: If you detonate them at key structural locations, that entire eyesore will collapse in on itself.

lines.label: A3M1-C020-080-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It seems you’ve saved us all, my friend.

lines.label: A3M1-C020-090-BERND
lines.speaker: Bernd
lines.text: Just returning the favor.

lines.label: A3M1-C020-100-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Then our course of action is clear. Garek, I entrust you with Naxxramas's destruction.

lines.label: A3M1-C020-110-SYLVANAS
lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: The rest of our unlikely alliance will defend the Undercity until you return.

lines.label: A3M1-C020-120-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It will be done, Dark Lady.

lines.label: A3M1-T180-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I will join you for the assault on Naxxramas. I may know where the explosives will do the most damage.

lines.label: A3M1-T190-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Leonid, how do you know where to place the explosives?

lines.label: A3M1-T200-LEONID
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I have walked the halls of Naxxramas before... as one of the Scourge. I still remember everything I saw within it.

lines.label: A3M1-T210-ANYA
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You were at Stratholme, then. That's where it was brought after being torn Northrend's frozen wastes.

lines.label: A3M1-T220-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Stratholme... why do I...

lines.label: A3M1-T230-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: No. It's not important now. All that matters is our mission.

lines.label: A3M1-T240-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We have to reach the skybarge fast or we'll be overwhelmed!

lines.label: A3M1-T250-NECROMANCERMORKATH
lines.speaker: Necromancer Morkath
lines.text: Intruders! Your traitorous kind will kneel to the Scourge!

lines.label: A3M1-T260-GAREK
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Quickly, to the skybarge! Before reinforcements arrive!

unplayed.label: A3M1-T090-GAREK
